The '''''Starblue Ranger''''' was a [[ILH-KK Citadel-class civilian cruiser|ILH-KK ''Citadel''-class civilian cruiser]] owned by the [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] [[Hunting/Legends|hunter]] known as [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Shorwarr]]. The Wookiee, who made a living hunting predatory [[Nexu/Legends|nexu]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Cholganna/Legends|Cholganna]], used the [[Starship/Legends|starship]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] between the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]].<ref name="BTR" /> The ship, from a line of armored [[Transport/Legends|transports]] manufactured by [[Koensayr Manufacturing/Legends|Koensayr Manufacturing]],<ref name="SotG1" /> was customized to included cages and storage compartments in the [[Hull/Legends|hull]].<ref name="BTR" />

==Behind the scenes==
The ''Starblue Ranger'' first appeared in [[2013]] in ''[[Beyond the Rim]]'', an adventure module written by [[Sterling Hershey]] for the [[Fantasy Flight Games]] roleplaying game, ''[[Star Wars: Edge of the Empire]]''. It was not involved in the books main campaign storyline but included in a suggestion for a potential extension of the story at the end of the book.
